title: Interactive checkpoint flows + annotated screenshot pack for first-run console tour
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Objective: Produce a handoff-ready design bundle (Figma + PNG/JPEG exports + annotated screenshots) for the Console first-run tour and quickstart checklist. Deliver an accessible, localized-ready set of assets that engineering and docs can consume for the 2026.03 release.

Scope: 1) First-run checklist flow: four checkpoint screens (Account setup -> Model selection -> Route creation -> Live test). 2) Empty states: 3 variants per surface (routes, models, logs). 3) Inline contextual tips: tooltip/spotlight treatment for 8 hotspots. 4) Two screenshot sets: annotated (callouts + copy suggestions) and production-ready (export sizes). 5) Assets for docs: mobile and desktop assets, thumbnail sizes, and an animated GIF for the quickstart hero.

Deliverables: - Figma file with named frames and component variants. - PNG/JPEG exports at 1x/2x for desktop and mobile. - Annotated PDF (design notes + implementation hints). - Accessibility checklist (contrast, focus order, keyboard walkthrough). - Localized copy variants for EN/ES/FR (strings file). - A/B test variants for CTA microcopy ("Run test" vs "Try sample").

Acceptance criteria: - All 4 checkpoint screens exported in production sizes and visually match the approved UI tokens. - Annotated screenshots include explicit spacing/measurement callouts and aria/role guidance for engineers. - Contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text. - Animations exported as a max-3s GIF and a Lottie placeholder. - Figma components documented with states (default, hover, focus, disabled). - PM signoff recorded and a GitHub PR opened that references the artifact folder.

Success metrics (for release tracking): - Onboarding completion rate improves by >= 10% for new accounts within 7 days. - Time-to-first-request reduced by 20% for users who follow the tour. - Fewer support tickets referencing "where to create routes" in the first 14 days after release (target: -30%).

Notes on approach: Use progressive disclosure: keep each checkpoint focused to one primary CTA. For technical screenshots prefer real-console data (sanitized) to maximize fidelity; mock data should be flagged clearly. Include a lightweight overlay variant for users on low-bandwidth (static images + captions). Ensure all copy strings are exported into a simple CSV for localization.

Implementation hints for engineering: - Use the existing spotlight component (token: spotlight-v2) and add a subtle 6px blurred backdrop. - Provide an enterprise-safe fallback that reduces telemetry calls when running the tour. - Prefer SVG exports for icons and PNG for full-screen screenshots.

Stakeholders: Product owner - Mateo Rivera; Eng lead - Kiran Patel; Docs - Hannah Ortiz.

a11y_considerations: Contrast checks run in Figma tokens; focus order documented; keyboard-only walkthrough recorded as short video. Tooltips include aria-label examples and role suggestions. Recommend engineering implement aria-live for progress updates in the checklist.
screenshot_requirements: Capture real-console data when possible; redact PII; use 2x exports for retina. For empty states include a micro-copy variant for product-led vs enterprise customers. Provide both light and dark mode screenshots.
release_notes_blurb: Adds a first-run interactive tour and compact quickstart checklist to guide new teams through account setup, model selection, route creation, and a live smoke test. Includes annotated screenshots and localization-ready copy files.
